identity: We have a second mathematician, this time as a result of deliberate experimentation.  We went through two dozen possible volunteers with no results other than severe headaches and time in the infirmary (apparently that first anomaly was very lucky) before we found someone who could make the matrix crystal work.  Now M81 demonstrates control over heat and fire; under controlled lab conditions he was able to increase the heat of a fire by 27.3° C simply by looking at it.  What else can these crystals do?
